Parameters ---------- author_name : str Identifier of the post's creator. title : str Heading of the user's post. body_content : str Primary content of the user's post. tag_list : list[str] Sequence of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str A fully escaped HTML string suitable for safe rendering in a browser. """ # Escape all user supplied content to neutralise special HTML characters. safe_author = html.escape(author_name, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body_content, quote=False) # Preserve newlines # Wrap each tag in a element, escaping the tag text. escaped_tags = [ f"{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}" for tag in tag_list ] tags_html = "".join(escaped_tags) # Construct the final HTML using the template. return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( author_name=safe_author, title=safe_title, body=safe_body, tags=tags_html )
